<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>public</access><active>true</active><api_name>x_1519575_traini_1.BaseUtils</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>true</client_callable><description/><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>BaseUtils</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script><![CDATA[var BaseUtils = Class.create();
BaseUtils.prototype = Object.extendsObject(global.AbstractAjaxProcessor, {

	validateBaseName: function() {
		var base = this.getParameter("sysparm_base");

		var gr = new GlideRecord("x_1519575_traini_1_base_registry");
		gr.addQuery("name", base);
		gr.query();

		if(gr.next()) {
			return "true";
		}
		return "false";
	},

	validateCityState: function () {
		var city = this.getParameter("sysparm_city");
		var state = this.getParameter("sysparm_state");

		var grState = new GlideRecord("x_1519575_traini_1_base_registry");
		grState.addQuery("state", state);
		grState.query();

		if(grState.next()) {
			var grCity = new GlideRecord("x_1519575_traini_1_base_registry")
			grCity.addQuery("state", state);
			grCity.addQuery("city", city);
			grCity.query();

			if(grCity.next()) {
				return "true";
			}
			return "false";
		}
	},

    type: 'BaseUtils'
});]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-10-20 14:12:10</sys_created_on><sys_id>13b54f40c3b8b210554f9e377d0131bf</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>BaseUtils</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Base Management" source="x_1519575_traini_1">b7d57e2fc398ba1053f8f8ddd4013195</sys_package><sys_policy>read</sys_policy><sys_scope display_value="Base Management">b7d57e2fc398ba1053f8f8ddd4013195</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_13b54f40c3b8b210554f9e377d0131bf</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-10-20 14:12:10</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include></record_update>
